traditional_equity_reference_price.definition: Benchmark quote from official NASDAQ/NYSE market sessions during regular hours (09:30-16:00 ET). Stale/frozen outside market hours.

token_market_price.definition: Secondary AMM swap rate or order-book clearing price on DEXes (e.g. PancakeSwap). Trades 24/7 with independent liquidity, slippage, and volatility.

multiplier_scale_factor.definition: Dynamic multiplier or balance scaling factor accounting for accrued dividend distributions and corporate actions.
multiplier_scale_factor.unit: Dimensionless scaling ratio (Shares per Raw Token or Display Balance per Raw Token)

share_equivalent.definition: Effective physical/custodial underlying share quantity represented by a given token quantity after applying accounting conversion factor.
share_equivalent.formula: Raw Token Balance * Accounting Conversion Factor (Multiplier or Scale Factor)

share_equivalent_reference_value.definition: Total monetary reference value computed as (Share Equivalent * Traditional Equity Reference Price).

reference_deviation.definition: Percentage divergence between Secondary DEX Market Price and Share-Equivalent Reference Value: ((DEX Price - Reference Value per Token) / Reference Value per Token) * 100.
reference_deviation.validity_constraint: ONLY valid during traditional market open hours with synchronized timestamps. Misleading during off-market hours or low liquidity pools.
